Simple by design

A small ritual for the cats you notice.

The public map moves quickly. Your Journal keeps the memory. Every step is built to reward care, not chasing.

01

Spot

Use the camera when you meet a cat out in the world. No gallery uploads for streaks.

02

Check

A quick check confirms there is a cat and keeps duplicate or unsafe posts out.

03

Pin

Your sighting appears as a delayed, approximate area—not an exact point someone can follow.

04

Collect

Earn a little XP, grow your streak, and keep the cat in your private Cat Journal.

Protection comes first

A softer map for a more careful world.

Pawprint is playful, but cats are not collectibles to be chased. Safety features are part of the core product.

  • ✓Approximate and delayed Public pins never reveal exact locations or live movement.
  • ✓Care flags Mark a cat that may need help without pretending to diagnose.
  • ✓Easy reporting Unsafe spots, harmful content, and privacy concerns can be surfaced quickly.
  • ✓Human behaviour matters The app reminds people not to chase, touch, or use flash at night.

Made for the everyday

Enough game to keep you coming back.

Streaks with breathing room

Spot once a day to keep your run going. A weekly Freeze and planned Rest Day keep it human.

Rarity that stays local

A coat pattern can be common in one place and rare in another. The map learns with the community.

Care is never premium

Care Flags, reporting, and safety tools stay available to everyone from day one.

The path ahead

Start small. Grow with the cats.

The first version proves the core loop in Alabang. The rest should earn its place through real use.
